vibe: Bold modern SaaS feel blended with a clean, trustworthy civic/community foundation. Grounded, physical, authoritative.

heading_sizes.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-black

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Use p-8, p-12, p-16 for structural padding.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.

grid_modes.landing: The 'Tetris' Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with wide gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetrical span logic.
grid_modes.dashboard: The 'Control Room' Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 with tight gap-4 or gap-6.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px crisp borders (border-border). No default shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and soft shadow-lg.
surfaces_and_borders.header: Crystal Glassmorphism if content scrolls under: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F9F6]/70 border-b border-[#E2E1D9]/50.
surfaces_and_borders.dashboard_widgets: Neumorphic tactile variant mixed with grid borders. Soft backgrounds matching parent, sharp 1px inner contrast borders.

components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#163832] text-white hover:bg-[#215249] rounded-none or rounded-sm. Accent: bg-[#CC5A47] text-white. Apply consistent right/left paddings.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults heavily customized: bg-white border border-[#E2E1D9] focus:border-[#163832] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#163832].
components.nav: Visible navigation bar on desktop with Logo + 3-5 links + CTA. No hamburger on desktop.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Never use native raw inputs.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Always explicitly set text color on hover. e.g., hover:bg-[#163832] hover:text-white.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use specific transition properties, not 'all'. transition-transform duration-200 ease-out.
interactions_and_motion.focus: Focus states must have higher contrast than default state.

images.description: Minimalist abstract 3D illustration of finding common ground. Use in landing page hero or about section.
Subtle texture for authentication pages (login/signup) split-screen background.
Friends in park - use for community engagement or 'Posts/Discussions' feature highlight.
Woman smiling - use for matching or connection feature highlight.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React and Tailwind CSS.
Do NOT use HTML raw components for complex UI like Tabs, Modals, Dropdowns. Use Shadcn components and customize them using Tailwind classes to match this design guide.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements for testing.
When displaying user posts or matching screens, ensure generous spacing and crisp borders.
Avoid centering everything. Use left alignment for readable community discussions and feeds.
Implement the MVP features: Authentication (Email + Google), User Profiles & Matching, Posts/Discussions, Admin Dashboard.
